'''Xelbree''' was one of the [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracers]] who participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|''Boonta Eve Classic'']]. His [[Podracer/Legends|pod]] was sabotaged by [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]].
